system.name: System
system.description: A system is a set of planets, moons, and other celestial bodies that orbit a common center of mass. Each system has a unique name and may contain multiple planets and moons.

children.name: Planet
children.description: A planet is a celestial body that orbits a star and has sufficient mass to assume a nearly round shape. Each planet has a unique name and may have multiple moons.

children.name: Moon
children.description: A moon is a natural satellite that orbits a planet. Each moon has a unique name and may have its own characteristics and features.
